svg.text: Phase 2 · step 8h · The Documents tab and license plates: two options
Official documents (title, registration, insurance; the kind's profile lists them, or the household's own) with scans and renewals; the vehicle's license plates, the current one in its header.
A · One column of cards: the plate first, then each current document; history folded below each
Since 1 Jun 2024 · expires 31 Oct 2027 (from its registration)
Expired ones (not renewed) stay in the list, marked Expired, until renewed or removed.
B · List and detail, like the Issues tab: documents on the left, the chosen one (with its history) on the right
Wide · Test truck, Documents, Registration chosen
Phone · the list; tap one for its page
− One more tap to see a
− The plate is a link, not
Both · The dialogs: a document (add, renew, edit) and a plate
Wide · Renew a registration; add a plate
A new record; the 2025 one is kept as history.
Scans: add them on its card once it's saved.
The current one (NC · NCX 4471) is retired on its issue date.
A plate moved over from the identifiers (no state yet) shows "Choose who issued it" on its card, and Edit opens this dialog.
Removing: a document only if nothing renews it (with its scans); a plate only if no registration names it.
